notes: Migrates Campaigns and Content Studio to the shared Kairo shell introduced by VS-50.
Makes Campaign work list-first and moves Campaign creation into progressive disclosure.
Makes the Content Studio writing surface primary while AI assistance, version history, evidence and detailed Critic findings remain accessible through contextual disclosure.
Preserves exact-version review, destination-specific approval, account-group distribution, scheduling and manual-publishing fallbacks without changing their server actions or contracts.
No API, domain, database, provider, publishing, deployment or production changes are introduced.

approvals.rationale: Owner instructed Go next immediately after VS-51 merged, authorizing the next bounded design-remediation slice from Issue #94: Campaigns + Content Studio.
VS-52 changes presentation hierarchy and shell adoption only; FR-10 through FR-13 and product/DESIGN.md remain authoritative.
Owner instruction authorizes bounded UI implementation, deterministic checks, UI review and PR preparation; certification, merge, release and production remain separate gates.
Requires exact-head Product Intake, Security and CI evidence plus UI Review before explicit merge approval.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Users can move from Campaign direction into a calm writing-first Studio, use AI and evidence context only when needed, and understand exact-version review/approval state without a dense control dashboard.
